descriptions.w3d_f2a_update_property_vectors_800642ac: Resolves caller offset 28, multiplies caller float offsets 84 and 44, samples the property at offset 144, and writes scale/sample fields through 0x8018963c. Queries 0x80189518 twice to set three-float fields at offsets 12 and 24 from the original constants and computed product. Frame storage and names are inferred; external data ownership is not claimed.
